title: CC-4DGS compressed deformation Mirror role code
hypothesis: A compact scene/motion coordinate at the CC-4DGS CDF deterministic feature interface can generate multiple useful dynamic deformation functions from shared compressed CDF+CCA state with lower actual serialized payload than independent per-scene/motion assets, while retaining quality and rendering throughput.
physical_object: Shared CC-4DGS deterministic dense hash features, compact CDF decoder, canonical Gaussian attributes and CCA compressed bundle
mirror_coordinate: Scene/motion View code m at the CDF feature input
logical_multiplicity: Multiple distinct scene or motion deformation functions backed by one paid CDF+CCA physical object
controls_required: Shared CDF with ordinary scene/motion embedding
Independent per-scene/motion CDF assets when practical

quality.success_gate: Not frozen; lock thresholds and held-out scene-time-view cells before fresh evaluation.

blocker: Official CC-4DGS was validated with CUDA 11.8/RTX 4090, builds CUDA rasterizer/simple-knn extensions, uses CUDA-bound paths, and ships no dataset files. Current runtime is CPU-only and N3DV/Technicolor scenes are absent.
boundaries: Feasibility review only; no PSNR, payload, or FPS evidence.
The reduced random-weight CPU CDF smoke is not trained-model or Mirror evidence.
A function-distortion/bytes screen with released checkpoints would require a new scoped amendment and cannot certify rendered quality/FPS.
Do not replace the official renderer with a toy CPU rasterizer and claim the registered frontier.
